2. The applicants applying in response to this advertisement should satisfy themselves regarding
their eligibility for the post applied for. They must be fulfilling eligibility criteria in all respects as on the
date of interview.

3. The following candidates can appear for the walk-in interview in the discipline of Emergency
Medicine and Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation in addition to their own specialty:

For Emergency Medicine - Candidates from the specialties of General Medicine, Anaesthesia,
Respiratory Medicine, General Surgery and Orthopaedics can appear for the walk-in interview in addition
to their own specialty.

For Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation - Candidates from the specialties of General Medicine with
Diploma in PMR, General Surgery and Orthopaedics can appear for the walk-in interview in addition to

Important Instructions: -

(a) All the candidates are advised to appear for document verification along with filled application form as
attached within the scheduled time (09.00AM — l.00 AM). No candidate will be entertained to attend
document verification after !l.00 AM on all scheduled dates as mentioned above.

(b) Only those candidates whose documents are verified will be allowed to attend walk-in interview.
(c) Reservation of posts is applicable as per Government of India Guidelines.

(d) Seventeen Posts in Senior Resident (3 years’ tenure) are horizontally reserved for PwD category in
identified posts.

(e) The Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital reserves the right to vary these vacancies including
increase or decrease or cancellation of filling up of any or all post without assigning any reason.

(f) Change in date of interview, etc. if any, will be intimated on website only. Candidates are advised to
check the website regularly for any updated information relating to the recruitment. Other terms and
conditions as mentioned in Annexure “A”.

(g) The engagement will be subject to outcome in case of recruitment related litigations if any.

In case of turnout of candidates is more than the ratio of :0 per post, the competent authority at their
own discretion may conduct a screening test to shortlist the candidates for the interview. The screening
test will consist of multiple choice questions in the concerned discipline. Top five will be called for the
interview. The marks obtained in the screening test will not in any way be linked to the final selection
process. The performance of the candidate in the interview will be the sole criteria for selecting the
candidate for the respective post. Mere participation in the screening test will not confer any claim for the
post.

(i) The aspiring applicants satisfying the eligibility criteria in all respects can appear for the

Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID)  
Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd. (POWERGRID) is a ‘Maharatna’ Central Public Sector Enterprise under 
the Ministry of Power, Government of India and one of the largest Transmission Utilities in the World. The 
Company is engaged in the power transmission  business, especially in inter -State segment and has been the 
key to achievement of One Nation -One Grid -One Frequency.   
 
PowerTel  
POWERGRID Teleservice Limited – PowerTel is a wholly owned subsidiary of Power Grid Corporation of India

and internet services to customers across the co untry, utilizing overhead optic fiber network (Optical Ground

INTERVIEW FOR ENGAGEMENT OF GYNAECOLOGY CONSULTANT (IVF) AT AIIMS 
BHOPAL PURELY ON CONTRACTUAL BASIS 
            
All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Bhopal will hold an Interview for engagement of 01 
Gynaecology Consultant (IVF) on purely contractual basis with consolidated monthly remuneration. 
  
For details of essential eligibility criteria, terms & conditions of engagement, application form, 
application procedure and the date(s) of document verification & Interview, the detailed 
advertisement may be referred on the Institute’s website-www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in. Candidates 
fulfilling the eligibility criteria and aspiring to attend the interview may submit their application in the 
prescribed format within 2 weeks of the publication of this advertisement on the institute website, 
to recruitment.contractual@aiimsbhopal.edu.in. The date of interview and document verification 
shall be notified separately on Institute’s website only.

prescribed format along with proof of identity, date of birth, eligibility 
qualification mark sheets, degrees, experience certificates, No objection 
certificate and other relevant documents (in original) in support of their eligibility 
along with 02 sets of self-attested photocopies & application fee in form of Demand 
Draft (if applicable) at the time of document verification/Interview. 
2. The applicants applying in response to this advertisement should satisfy themselves 
regarding their eligibility for the aforesaid post and must fulfill all the eligibility 
criteria before applying. 
3. The schedule of document verification and Interview will be intimated separately on 
the Institute's website only. 
4. Applicants are advised to visit the Institute’s website regularly for further updates.  
5. On the day of DV/Interview, the candidate is required to be present "in person" with 
all original certificates along with 02 sets of self-attested photocopies at the venue of 
the following documents: 
i. Filled Application Form 
ii. Three passport size photographs  
iii. Proof of application fee paid 
iv. Residential Proof and Valid Govt. photo-ID proof 
v. Proof of age 
vi. Age relaxation document (if applicable) 
vii. Caste Certificates in Central Govt. Format (if applicable) 
viii. All Educational Certificates  
ix. Experience Certificates and salary slips, if any. 
x. NOC documents (if applicable) 
xi. Other relevant documents in support of their candidature 
6. The above schedule is tentative and the Institute reserves the right to cancel or 
reschedule the same depending upon the availability of Selection Panel or other 
Administrative reasons. 
7. Candidates who fail to produce valid caste/category certificate during document 
verification/Interview or as and when required to produce the same, the candidature of 
such candidates is liable to be cancelled. All candidates are therefore advised to 
ensure that they possess required valid caste/category certificate in advance. 
8. The Executive Director, AIIMS Bhopal reserves the right to reschedule the above 
date, time and venue at any stage of interview. 
9. The above vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. The Executive Director, 
AIIMS Bhopal reserves the right to vary the vacancy including reserved vacancies as 
per the GoI rules/circulars and as per Institute's requirements. The reservation is as 
per the guidelines of MoHFW/Government of India. 
10. Age, Experience and all prescribed qualifications shall be counted as on the date of 
publication of this advertisement on the institute website. 
11. The engagement will be purely on contractual basis and under no circumstances are 
linked to regular appointments and cannot be regularized at any stage. If the 
contract is not extended further, the same will lapse automatically.  
 
12. The emoluments will be consolidated in nature as determined by the Competent 
Authority and nothing additional will be paid. The appointment can be terminated by 
the competent authority any time (before one year also), without assigning any reason 
thereof. 
13. The period of experience, wherever prescribed, shall be counted after obtaining 
the prescribed qualifications. For posts having experience as an Essential Criteria, 
the experience which has been acquired only after obtaining Essential Qualification, 
will considered as valid. 
14. The Executive Director, AIIMS Bhopal reserve the rights to cancel the advertisement 
at any point of time without prior   notice or fill up less number of posts as advertised 
depending upon the institutional requirements.  
15.    Application Fees: 
 The application fee for EWS/General/OBC category Rs. 1,000/-. (Rs. One Thousand 
Only). 
 Application fee is to be paid by Demand Draft only drawn in favour of “Executive 
Director AIIMS, Bhopal”. 
 No application fee for PwBD/SC/ST and women Candidates. 
 Fee once remitted will not be refunded. 
 Applications without the prescribed fee shall be summarily rejected. 
   
17. No Objection Certificate: Those who are working in Central/State Government/ 
/Semi Government/ Autonomous body/PSU shall be required to submit “No 
Objection Certificate” from their respective organization at the time of document 
verification/interview, as and when demanded, failing which the candidate will not be 
permitted to attend the interview and the candidature will be rejected. 
18.  Age Limit:  
The age of the candidates should be up to 50 years as on the date of publication of 
this advertisement on the institute website. Age relaxation for candidates belonging 
to different categories shall be applicable as per Government of India rules/orders. 
  
Reservation: As per Government of India rules. 
  
20. PwBD Candidates may apply against the identified posts for PwBD. Applicants with 
   disabilities mentioned in Section 32 (1) of Rights of Persons with Disability Act, 
2016, are eligible to apply under this category provided they have benchmark 
disability (equal to or more than 40%). 
21. Place of Interview: The document verification / interview will be held at 
Administrative Block, Kautilya Bhawan, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, 
Saket Nagar Bhopal-462020 
22. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. 
23. The Executive Director, AIIMS Bhopal reserves the right to reschedule the date and 
time of Interview/ Document Verification & venue at any stage.  
24. Short listing: After scrutiny/verification of the documents as per eligibility 
criteria/conditions, only eligible candidates will be permitted to appear before the 
selection committee for interview. Candidates reporting for document verification 
must bring a printed copy of the application form.  
 
OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS  
1. Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification. 
2. The prescribed qualification is minimum and mere possessing the same does not entitle 
any candidate for selection. 
3. The appointees shall be whole-time contractual employee of the institute and shall not 
accept any other assignment paid or otherwise and shall not engage him/her in a private 
practice or any kind during the service period. 
4. He/she is expected to conform to the rules of conduct and discipline as applicable to the 
institute employees. 
5. The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, 
Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits 
available/applicable to the Government Servants, appointed on regular basis. 
6. The engagement of selected candidates can also be terminated at any time, on either side, 
by giving one month's prior notice or by paying one month's salary, without assigning any 
reason to the satisfaction of competent authority. 
7. The appointee shall perform the duties assigned to him/her. The competent authority 
reserves the right to assign any duty as and when required. No extra/additional allowances 
will be admissible in case of such assignment. 
8. The appointee will be entitled to Thirty (30) days of leave in a calendar year calculated on 
a pro rata basis. 
9. The appointee shall not be entitled to avail any allowances/facilities being extended to the 
regular/permanent faculty members of the AIIMS. 
10. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. 
11. In case any information given or declaration by the candidate is found to be false or if the 
candidate has wilfully suppressed any material information relevant to this appointment, 
he/she will be liable to be removed from the service and any other action as deemed fit may 
be taken by the Competent Authority. 
12. The decision of the competent authority regarding selection of candidates will be final 
and no representations will be entertained in this regard. 
13. No Interim enquiries/correspondence/communication of any sort will be entertained on 
the matter. 
13. Applications incomplete in any aspect are liable to be summarily rejected. 
14. The Competent Authority, AIIMS Bhopal reserves the right to make any 
amendment/changes or to cancel this advertisement as a whole or in part without assigning 
any reason or giving notice. 
 
15. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection which may be detected at 
any stage even after the issue of appointment letter, the Institute reserves the right to 
modify/withdraw/cancel any communication made to the candidate. 
16. The selected candidate shall be required to serve the Institute for a minimum period of six 
(06) months from the date of joining. In the event of non-completion of the stipulated six-
month period due to any reason, the candidate shall be liable to pay ₹1,00,000/- (Rupees One 
Lakh only) to the Institute as penalty. The selected candidate shall be required to execute a 
Service Bond on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper, duly attested by Notary Public, at the time of 
joining. 
17. The appointment can also be terminated at any time, on either side, by giving one 
month’s notice or by paying one month’s salary, without assigning any reason or failure to 
complete the period of three months to the satisfaction of competent authority. The appointee 
shall be on the whole time appointment of the AIIMS Bhopal and shall not accept any other 
assignment, paid or otherwise and shall not engage himself/herself in a private practice of any 
kind during the period of contract. The appointee shall perform the duties assigned to 
him/her. The competent authority reserves the right to assign any duty as and when required. 
No extra/additional allowances will be admissible in case of such assignment. 
18. Joining to the aforesaid post of selected candidate shall be subject to the Production of 
Medical Fitness Certificate from the Medical Board of AIIMS Bhopal before joining the post. 
In case, found medically unfit, the engagement order may be withdrawn.  
19. Any corrigendum or revision of the advertisement or any other information regarding this 
recruitment and for confirmation about the date and time/venue will be posted on the Official 
Website of AIIMS Bhopal. No personal/by post information will be sent. Candidates are 
advised to visit our website regularly for updated information in this regard. 
20. In case the number of candidates is more than 1:10 ratio a screening test may be 
conducted. 
21. All disputes will be subject to jurisdictions of Court of Law at Bhopal.

IIT-Bombay  E-RECRUITMENT System
E-Recruitment applicant’s Manual 
All Job applicants can access the employment opportunities as Unregistered and Fresh applicants. 
Unregistered applicants will be able to view/search all the employment opportunities published by IIT 
Bombay. To proceed further in applying for jobs, registration is necessary. Once registration is 
completed successfully, email verification will be sent to the applicant and then applicant is allowed to 
log on to the Applicant Cockpit. 
E-Recruitment Applicant Cockpit is an integrated application which provides an access to the  
candidate’s applications such as Candidate Profile, Job Search and Applications. 
Fresh Applicants will be able to view/search all the employment opportunities and apply.
They will be able to do further activities such as search for jobs, update the profile and check the 
status of applications by logging into the Applicant Cockpit.
Prerequisites to Start
Please note that once you have registered, you will use the created username to access this site in 
future.
The following browsers are recommended by IITB-ERP for use with the e-Recruiting system:
 Chrome 
 Firefox 
 Microsoft Internet Explorer  
If you use any other different browser and are not able to access the system, please switch to any 
of the above recommended browser.
For personal security and to prevent illegal access to your profile, please always remember to click 
“Log off” 
  link before leaving the system, especially if you are using a public computer.
Most screens are opened and displayed in new windows. If you have suppressed the display of 
additional windows with a popup blocker, you must deactivate this for this application.

Ref No: BHEL/PSER/PTMC/2026/02               Date: 13.11.2026 
 
1. BHEL, Power Sector Eastern Region, Kolkata invites application from Medical 
Professionals meeting the required specifications to engage them as Part Time Medical 
Consultants (General Duty Medical Officer- MBBS) initially for a period of 
01(One) year for the position mentioned below: -

2. Number of Vacancy: -  
i) There is a requirement of total 6 hours duty / day for 5 days in a week. 
ii) Number of Posts for the said engagement of PTMC are 
a. 2 (Two) for 3 hours duty/ day  
or  
b. 1 (One) for 6 hours duty/ day 
 
3. Conditions for Engagement: -  
a. Educational Qualification: - Candidates applying for the above posts should have their 
MBBS Degree recognized by the Medical Council of India. 
b. Candidates applying for the above posts must be a member of Medical Council of India/State 
Medical Council. 
c. Post Qualification Experience - Minimum One (01) Year as on 01.11.2026. 
d. UPPER AGE LIMIT:  65 years (as on 01/11/2026), however, the age limit may be relaxed up 
to 70 years with specific approval from the Competent Authority.   
e. TENURE: The engagement is purely on Temporary basis for a period of 01(One) Year and 
payable on hourly basis.  Subsequent renewal(s) will be limited to a period of maximum 3 

 
 
 
years, subject to satisfactory performance and at the discretion of the Management. The 
tentative date of joining will be in the First week of December - 2026. 
f. WORKING HOURS: The working hours for PTMC will be for a minimum of 03 (three) hours 
and maximum of 06 (six) hours in a day for maximum 05 (five) days in a week (Monday to 
Friday). There will be no working on BHEL declared holiday for Kolkata. 
g. Management has the right to change the working hours based on requirement and 
availability of candidates. 
h. There will be a notice period of one month, on either side, for discontinuing the part time 
engagement. 
i. CONVEYANCE CHARGES: In case of local travel, (up to 30 KMs one-way), conveyance charges 
will be payable on actual basis, with the upper ceiling of Rs. 4500/- per month and beyond 
30 KMs one-way, with an upper ceiling of Rs. 6000/- per month on case to case basis. 
j. Payment towards Remuneration and Conveyance will be against submission of invoice as 
independent professional for rendering the services. 
k. Interested candidate meeting all the criteria, can apply for a Maximum of Two Post Code. 
 
 
4. SELECTION PROCESS: Selection process will be through personal interview of eligible 
candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to Candidates called for interview. 
5. MEDICAL FITNESS: The Applicant should have sound health and the appointment shall 
be subject to meeting the good health standards. The selected candidate will have to 
produce medical fitness certificate from a registered medical practitioner, at the time of 
joining.  
 
6. HOW TO APPLY 
 
Interested candidates may download the blank application form for engagement of Part 
Time Medical Consultant, attached with this advertisement from BHEL website 
https://pser.bhel.com/  or  https://careers.bhel.in  and send the duly filled in application 
form along with relevant documents (self-attested) by Post, super scribing the envelope 
as “Application for post of PTMC” to  SR MANAGER (HR),  HRM Dept., BHEL BHAWAN, BLOCK-DJ, PLOT-9/1, SECTOR-II, SALT LAKE CITY, KOLKATA- 700 091 or alternatively 
they can send the application through email  to “ akshaw@bhel.in” so as to reach on or 
before 28.11.2026  (17.30 hrs).  
 
Document to be sent along with the application 
 
1. DOB Proof- SSC/ Matriculation Certificate 
2. MBBS Certificate and Mark Sheet/s 
3. Registration Certificate for MBBS issued by Medical Council of India or by State Medical 
Council. 
4. In case of retired professional, Superannuation/Retirement along with Reliving order from 
their previous employer where he/she was engaged prior to application to BHEL.  
5. In case of working professional, they must submit their Last Salary Slip / Joining Order.  
 
 
   
 
 
 
 GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS 
 
 Applications received in any format other than the prescribed application form, applications 
received after the last date / incomplete applications will not be considered and no 
correspondence in this regard will be entertained.  
 
 BHEL reserves the right to reschedule/cancel/suspend/terminate the process without assigning 
any reasons and alter the terms and conditions at any time due to any exigency.  The decision of 
the management will be final and no appeal in this regard will be entertained. 
 
 The candidates should ensure while applying that they fulfill the essential eligibility criteria and 
other requirements prescribed for the above position and that the particulars furnished by them 
are correct in all respect. In case, it is detected at any stage that the candidate does not fulfill the 
essential eligibility criteria and / or does not comply with other requirements and / or he/she 
has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any relevant information/ 
material facts, his /her candidature is liable to be rejected. If any of the above shortcomings 
is/are detected, even after appointment, his/her services are liable to be terminated. 
 
 Candidates retired from BHEL under ’Pre Mature Retirement Scheme’ will be governed by the Pre Mature Retirement policy of BHEL.   No correspondence will be entertained from the candidates not selected for Interview / 
Engagement as PTMC/PTMCs. 
 
 Candidate who is unable to produce relevant documents as proof of qualification and 
experience will be disqualified. No correspondence in this regard shall be entertained. 
 
 Any form of canvassing or bringing external pressure will be liable to be disqualified and will 
render the candidate ineligible for engagement as PTMC. 
 
 Corrigendum/updates/extension and any other information etc., if any, shall be published in our 
website https://pser.bhel.com/ and https://careers.bhel.in/  
 
 Candidates are advised to posses a valid e-mail ID. They are also advised to keep this e-mail ID 
active for a period of minimum 1 year, as any important intimation to them shall be provided by 
BHEL through e-mail. 
 
 
SR MANAGER (HR)
